Defect Description: Hardcoded fallback UUIDs (00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001/2/3) substituted when optional inputs are omitted
Impact: Violates zero-trust patient/tenant isolation; risks corrupting billing ledger under invalid input
Root Cause: Defensive programming pattern silently substituting fictitious IDs instead of throwing 400 Bad Request

Defect Description: Hardcoded fallback organizationId, branchId, and tenantId UUIDs in transactional billing methods
Impact: Corrupts multi-tenant accounting ledger; can associate invoices with invalid default organizations
Root Cause: Hardcoded fallback strings used instead of resolving from authenticated request context

Defect Description: Database connection string uses postgres superuser with rolbypassrls=true, bypassing PostgreSQL Row Level Security across 399 tables
Impact: Database fails to enforce kernel-level multi-tenant isolation if an application query omits explicit tenantId filtering
Root Cause: Superuser credentials configured in default application connection string instead of least-privilege docsearch_app role

Defect Description: Table created with tenant identifier hospital_id but ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY was never executed
Impact: Cross-tenant data exposure of sensitive doctor poaching and cartel intelligence across competing hospitals
Root Cause: Ad-hoc table migration omitted RLS enablement and force commands

Defect Description: Table model declared in Drizzle TypeScript schema but migration DDL was never generated or executed against PostgreSQL
Impact: Unhandled 42P01 exception and HTTP 500 error on any attempt to log or inspect controlled substance dispensing in pharmacy
Root Cause: TypeScript schema created in clinical/index.ts:3095 without running migration generation toolchain

Defect Description: Migration numbering gap (missing 0071) and unjournaled migrations 0072 and 0073
Impact: Drizzle migration runner cannot track or safely apply migrations 0072/0073 in automated staging pipelines
Root Cause: Manual SQL files created without running drizzle-kit migrate or updating journal

Defect Description: drizzle.__drizzle_migrations table in PostgreSQL 18.4 contains 0 applied migration records
Impact: Schema migrations cannot be audited or rolled back incrementally via CLI tools; standard migrate runner fails closed
Root Cause: Database tables were seeded via initial SQL dump rather than recorded Drizzle migrations

Defect Description: Unrestricted DELETE statements targeting radiology appointments, reports, and emergency encounters
Impact: Risk of accidental clinical data loss if executed against a production database with orphaned test records
Root Cause: Synthetic test cleanup logic placed directly inside a production DDL migration file

Defect Description: 436 unindexed foreign key constraints out of 1017 total foreign keys (42.9% unindexed)
Impact: PostgreSQL executes full table sequential scans and acquires ShareRowExclusiveLock on parent updates/deletes causing deadlocks
Root Cause: Drizzle schema declarations omitted explicit index definitions on foreign key referencing columns

Defect Description: 81 clinical columns named patient_id, encounter_id, doctor_id, invoice_id lack foreign key constraints
Impact: Risk of dangling clinical records referencing non-existent patients/encounters; disables engine join elimination
Root Cause: Developer schema models declared bare uuid fields without references(() => ...) clauses

Defect Description: Auth tokens accepted via URL query parameters (?token= or ?sso_token=)
Impact: Token leakage risk through browser history, HTTP Referer headers, or proxy access logs
Root Cause: SSO cross-origin bootstrap pattern using URL query parameters instead of postMessage handshake

Defect Description: Unauthenticated GET /api/v1/auth/live-partners with optionalAuthenticate leaks partner names, emails, and phone numbers
Impact: Unauthenticated PII disclosure and partner account enumeration violating DPDP Act 2023 and HIPAA
Root Cause: Optional authentication applied to sensitive partner metadata endpoint

Defect Description: PATHOLOGIST_ROLES array omits 'PATHOLOGIST' role, blocking legitimate pathologists with 403 Forbidden on lab verification
Impact: Breaks clinical Separation of Duties (SoD); prevents certified pathologists from signing off on lab reports
Root Cause: Missing role literal in PATHOLOGIST_ROLES constant array

Defect Description: JWT authentication tokens extracted from URL query parameter (?token=)
Impact: Session tokens leak into server access logs, reverse proxy logs, browser history, and HTTP Referer headers
Root Cause: Permissive token extraction logic supporting legacy query string tokens

Defect Description: Rate limiter grants 10,000 req/min quota and creates unverified token keys from unverified base64 JWT payloads
Impact: Attacker can spoof claims without cryptographic signature to bypass IP throttling and flood auth endpoints
Root Cause: Rate limiter inspects unverified token payload before authentication guard runs

Defect Description: Hardcoded UUID updates patching specific clinical encounter IDs directly inside migration script
Impact: Data patching mixed into schema DDL; non-portable across multiple customer databases
Root Cause: One-off hotfix embedded directly in SQL migration instead of a data maintenance script

Defect Description: 54 tables in PostgreSQL missing from Drizzle TypeScript schema exports
Impact: Developers cannot query these tables type-safely via Drizzle ORM query builders
Root Cause: Tables created by auxiliary migration scripts without corresponding TypeScript schema models

Defect Description: Declarative partition parent tables lack primary key constraints
Impact: Permits potential duplicate rows in child partitions if partition keys are omitted from unique constraints
Root Cause: PostgreSQL declarative partitioning requires partition key in primary key constraint

Defect Description: Hardcoded offline auth bypass mints synthetic claims with permissions:['*'] and HOSPITAL_ADMIN when token starts with offline.
Impact: Privilege escalation and unauthorized backdoor risk if deployment configuration is misconfigured
Root Cause: Development bypass logic bundled directly inside production authentication guard

Defect Description: Plaintext ABHA number written directly to application log files via logger.info
Impact: Unmasked patient healthcare identifiers exposed to centralized log management systems, violating ABDM guidelines
Root Cause: Missing masking utility call on abhaNumber before string interpolation in log statement

Defect Description: VitePWA devOptions enabled in development mode with aggressive cache-first strategy
Impact: Causes tablet and mobile browsers to serve stale cached bundles even after backend/UI updates
Root Cause: PWA development mode caching enabled without cache-busting during active development

Defect Description: 580 tables across 9 schemas require high-traffic composite indices verification
Impact: Potential query degradation under high concurrent OPD and billing volume
Root Cause: Missing composite foreign key indices on high-volume clinical tables (superseded by P1-PERF-01)

Defect Description: PartnerPlatformShell.tsx is oversized (~3,500 lines) combining shell, modals, and navigation
Impact: Maintenance complexity and potential re-render performance bottlenecks
Root Cause: Monolithic shell component accumulating multiple concerns over development cycles

Defect Description: Doctor clinical OPD prescriptions write to clinical.prescriptions while /pharmacy/prescriptions queries pharmacy.prescriptions
Impact: Doctor prescriptions do not automatically project to pharmacy worklist queue without manual conversion
Root Cause: Separate schema tables for clinical prescriptions vs pharmacy queue

Defect Description: Rate limiter hook executes at onRequest before session authentication attaches request.session
Impact: Authenticated staff from a shared hospital NAT IP get throttled to the unauthenticated 100 req/min quota bucket
Root Cause: Rate limiter lifecycle executes before route preHandler

Defect Description: Background async queue imports node:fs which Vite externalizes for browser compatibility
Impact: Vite externalization warning defers initial client component hydration on cold start
Root Cause: Node built-in module imported inside browser SPA bundle

Defect Description: Standalone periodic snapshot backups provide RPO <= 6 hours; true sub-second PITR requires continuous WAL archiving
Impact: Disaster recovery from unexpected catastrophic failure between 6h cycles incurs up to 6h data delta
Root Cause: Snapshot-based backup architecture without continuous WAL streaming

Defect Description: In-memory test database omitted operationalPartners and operationalOrganizations seed rows
Impact: Negative test suite threw 404 hierarchy not provisioned on createPatient
Root Cause: Test harness omitted operational hierarchy seed data present in live DB

Defect Description: Vite client bundle logged module node:fs externalized for browser compatibility
Impact: Console warning and potential runtime reference exception in client code
Root Cause: Monolithic shared-core barrel export pulled server-only concurrency utilities into browser

Defect Description: PharmacyManagementService executed withSecurityContext() to set session context but omitted transaction handle tx in repository invocations, running queries on un-scoped pool connections where PostgreSQL RLS blocked all rows under docsearch_app role
Impact: Pharmacy worklist queues and dispensing queries returned 0 results for authenticated pharmacy staff under RLS enforcement; blocked prescription fulfillment
Root Cause: Repository methods were invoked with default database connection rather than scoped transaction object yielded by withSecurityContext
